member.name: T:SingularityFramework.Relics.Gizmo_RelicAptitude

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.Relics.RelicAptitude.Label(SingularityFramework.Relics.AptitudeLevel)

member.summary: Generates a descriptive summary of a pawn's aptitude for a specified relic, including current aptitude level and requirements for the next tier, if applicable.

member.name: F:SingularityFramework.Visuals.HediffCompProperties_Aura.onlyWhileDrafted

member.name: T:SingularityFramework.Visuals.WeaponEffects
member.summary: Spawns visual effects at points on a pawn's held weapon, as it's currently drawn (including animation mods). Positions along the weapon use the tip zone: 0 is the handle side, 1 is the tip. Falls back to the pawn's position when the weapon isn't visible.

member.summary: The world position of a point in the weapon's tip zone, and the angle the weapon runs at there. Returns false (with the pawn's position) when the weapon wasn't drawn recently.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.Visuals.WeaponEffects.TipInWorld(Verse.ThingDef,UnityEngine.Matrix4x4)
member.summary: The world position of a weapon's tip when the weapon's sprite is drawn with this matrix by something other than a pawn, such as a thrown weapon in flight. Uses the same tip point the shape analyzer finds for held weapons.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.Visuals.WeaponEffects.TryGetMuzzleInWorld(Verse.Pawn,UnityEngine.Vector3@)
member.summary: The world position of the weapon's muzzle (ranged weapons, or the gun part of a gunblade).

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.Visuals.WeaponEffects.ThrowFleckAtMuzzle(Verse.Pawn,Verse.FleckDef,System.Single)

member.summary: How wide a pawn's torso is in its body texture, and where the body starts and ends vertically. Results are cached per texture. Must run on the main thread, since it reads textures.

member.name: T:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.GameComponent_WeaponDrawCleanup
member.summary: Clears the framework's per-pawn caches when a game loads, and keeps the weapon draw records from holding onto pawns that are gone.

member.name: T:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.Patch_AnimRenderer_Draw
member.summary: Animation mods built on the AM.AnimRenderer (Melee Animation and the mods sharing its renderer) draw weapons themselves. After each animation frame, records every animated weapon's final transform, so effects anchored to the weapon follow the animation. Skipped entirely if no such renderer is installed.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.Patch_AnimRenderer_Draw.Prepare
member.summary: Finds AM.AnimRenderer's classes by name. Returning false makes Harmony skip this patch.

member.name: T:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.Patch_PawnRenderUtility_DrawEquipmentAiming
member.summary: Records where each held weapon is drawn, using the same angle and mirroring math as vanilla.

member.name: T:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponDrawRecord
member.summary: Where a pawn's weapon was drawn this frame. Filled by the vanilla drawing patch, and overridden by animation mod patches when they draw the weapon, so effects anchored to the weapon always follow it as it's actually shown.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponDrawRecord.RecordMatrix(Verse.Pawn,Verse.ThingDef,UnityEngine.Matrix4x4,System.Boolean,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Records a weapon drawn with a full transform matrix (for example by an animation mod). The matrix maps the weapon's quad (-0.5 to 0.5 on x and z) to the world, like vanilla's plane mesh.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponDrawRecord.TryGetCurrent(Verse.Pawn,SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponDrawRecord@)
member.summary: The pawn's weapon transform, only if it was drawn this frame (otherwise the weapon isn't visible).

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponDrawRecord.SpriteLengthToWorld(System.Single)
member.summary: Turns a length in sprite units into world units, using the weapon's average draw size.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponDrawRecord.SpritePointToWorld(UnityEngine.Vector2)
member.summary: Turns a point on the weapon's sprite (in sprite units, -0.5 to 0.5) into a position in the world.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponDrawRecord.RemoveStaleRecords
member.summary: Forgets pawns that are gone (destroyed, or dead and despawned), so the records don't grow forever.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponDrawRecord.ClearAll
member.summary: Forgets everything, e.g. when a game is loaded. Records rebuild on the next frame.

member.name: T:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponShape
member.summary: The shape of a weapon sprite, in sprite units (the texture spans -0.5 to 0.5). The tip zone is a stretch of the weapon's spine near its far end, where effects can attach to the weapon. Positions in the zone run from the handle side (0) toward the tip (1).

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponShape.TryGetZonePoint(System.Single,UnityEngine.Vector2@,UnityEngine.Vector2@,System.Single@)
member.summary: The point at a given fraction of the tip zone (0 = handle side, 1 = tip), which way the weapon runs there, and how wide it is.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponShape.TryGetSlotPlacement(System.Int32,System.Int32,UnityEngine.Vector2@,UnityEngine.Vector2@,System.Single@)
member.summary: Where slot number "slotIndex" (0 = handle side) of "slotCount" evenly spaced slots sits in the tip zone, for effects that line up several items along the weapon. A single slot goes in the middle.

member.name: T:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponShapeAnalyzer
member.summary: Works out the shape of any weapon from its texture: its forward direction, length, muzzle, and the tip zone where effects attach. Works for every weapon mod without per-weapon setup. Results are cached per weapon type. Must run on the main thread, since it reads textures.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponShapeAnalyzer.TryFindMeleeForward(UnityEngine.Color[],System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Single,UnityEngine.Vector2@)
member.summary: Finds a melee weapon's forward direction from its pixels: the long axis, pointing toward the heavier half (the blade or head), refined along the front part so hilts and crossguards don't tilt it.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponShapeAnalyzer.SliceCenter(UnityEngine.Color[],System.Int32,System.Int32,UnityEngine.Vector2,System.Single,System.Single)
member.summary: The average position of the visible pixels within the band around a point along the weapon.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponShapeAnalyzer.TryMeasureSlice(UnityEngine.Color[],System.Int32,System.Int32,UnityEngine.Vector2,UnityEngine.Vector2,System.Single,System.Single@,System.Single@)
member.summary: The weapon's width and center line across one slice. False if the slice has no visible pixels.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponShapeAnalyzer.ReadPixels(UnityEngine.Texture2D,System.Int32,System.Int32@,System.Int32@)
member.summary: Textures on the graphics card can't be read directly, so this copies one into a readable form. It's scaled down on the way so its longest side is at most "maximumSize" pixels; shape analysis works in sprite units, so it doesn't need full resolution, and big textures would be slow to scan.

member.name: M:SingularityFramework.WeaponAnchor.WeaponShapeAnalyzer.LocalPosition(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: A pixel's position in sprite units (-0.5 to 0.5), with Unity textures starting at the bottom-left.
